## Checklist

- [ ] Facts are backed by official documentation (linked in the lesson's `references`, or below).
- [ ] Commands I added or changed were run, or are marked as documented examples (`origin: example`). I did not
      invent command output.
- [ ] Accepted answers (`accept:`) are all correct commands; I ran `.venv/bin/python scripts/grading_oracle.py --file <lesson file>`
      when I changed them (needs the `oc` client, no cluster).
- [ ] `.venv/bin/python scripts/teach_lint.py` and `.venv/bin/python scripts/slugs.py --check` pass.
- [ ] No passwords, tokens, kubeconfigs, host names or personal data in the change.
- [ ] Course text is original: nothing copied from paid training material, exams or other copyrighted courses.
